acceptance: Use predecessor outputs; do not reimplement the basic extraction or candidate happy path.
Discover only eligible tenant-scoped learn handoffs through a service-owned authenticated contract; Policy Learning must not write Agora tables directly.
Persist a consumer receipt or idempotency key and create at most one Policy Learning job/candidate for one handoff despite duplicate delivery, restart, or two workers.
Acknowledge the Agora handoff only after durable downstream persistence succeeds; a failed persistence or lost lease leaves it safely retryable.
Bind acknowledgement to tenant, user, dataset version, digest, and consumer receipt; cross-tenant read/ack returns no foreign data and changes no row.
Prove one new learn flow reaches terminal shadow-candidate processing with no seed fallback and no runtime promotion authority.
Report historical pending counts but neither bulk-acknowledge nor relabel the 81 observe records.
